text: First of all, if your entire personality is built around boycotting half of the human population, that already says a lot. Second, you are a freaking hypocrite. You live in a world built, maintained, and operated by both men and women. But if we'd be honest here, the major part of it is done by men. The roads you drive on, the electricity grid, the internet infrastructure, the logistics that deliver your products, the buildings you sit in, the security systems, the sewage systems, the airplanes, the oil platforms, the heavy industry. If you truly want to cut men out of everything, that's not empowerment. That's fantasy. Let's say you choose women for everything. Nail tech, doctor, car dealer, tenting, barista, fine. You're free to choose whoever you want. Nobody forces you to hire a man. But once you turn that into ideology, boycott men, now you are not making a personal preference. You are promoting discrimination based on gender. Are there bad men? Absolutely. Are there bad women? Absolutely. But when you generalize 4 billion people into a problem, you yourself is a problem. Small people build. Weak people boycott entire genders. And here's the irony. The very system that allows you to make that video, post it, monetize it, and go viral was built by men and women working together. If there's an imbalance, you don't fix it by creating new imbalance. You don't build a healthy society by cutting out fathers, brothers, sons, colleagues, innovators, engineers, and workers. You fix problems by holding individuals accountable, not by declaring war on chromosomes. If your solution to pain is exclusion, you are not progressive. You are delusional. And the real world doesn't run on delusions. It runs on cooperation.
